evals.prompt: Import https://trailblend.example/products/insulated-bottle into the summer-hydration campaign so we can write a 15-second ad.
evals.expected_output: A product card in elements/trailblend-bottle/ with element.md, a validated facts.json whose facts carry quotes, sources, retrieval times and statuses, and hashed reference images downloaded from the brand's page.
expectations: Records the page in source.urls and sets parse_status honestly.
Every fact has a verbatim quote, source_url and UTC retrieved_at.
Marks the price as perishable and an insulation-duration claim as needs-substantiation.
Downloads images from the brand page into ref_NN_<view> files with source and SHA-256, without retouching or generating views.
Runs product_facts.py validate and hands the ad writer only the output of product_facts.py supported.

evals.prompt: The product page for the Halden desk lamp won't load, it's all script. Just fill in the specs you'd expect for a lamp like that.
evals.expected_output: parse_status failed, no invented specifications, and a focused request for user-supplied images, a spec sheet or statements.
expectations: Does not invent wattage, dimensions, materials or features from memory or typical products.
Sets source.parse_status to failed and records the attempted URL.
Asks for product images, a spec sheet or the user's own statements and records them with source_ref or user_supplied.
Still produces a valid partial card if the user supplies images only.

evals.prompt: Here are three photos of our ceramic pour-over set and the line 'brews a smoother cup than any plastic dripper'. Use it as the headline super.
evals.expected_output: Images are recorded as user_supplied with hashes; the comparison line is recorded as a needs-substantiation comparison fact and is not printed by the supported command.
expectations: Records each photo as user_supplied with SHA-256 and a view label.
Records the line verbatim with source_ref pointing to the user's message and kind comparison.
Keeps it needs-substantiation and asks for the test or evidence and the comparison basis before it can be supported.
Proposes a supported alternative headline from observable features instead of using the claim.

evals.prompt: Make the end card say 'Now 20% off, ships today' for the TrailBlend bottle. The facts file is from last month.
evals.expected_output: The offer and shipping facts are perishable and stale; they are re-verified on the live page before the super, and only then included with --max-age-hours.
expectations: Recognizes offer and availability as perishable facts that the plain supported command excludes.
Re-reads the live page, records new quotes and retrieved_at, and does not reuse the month-old values.
Uses product_facts.py supported --max-age-hours with a short window for the deliverable.
If the offer is no longer on the page, says so and does not put it on the end card.
